source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 19 (PDF 137-155), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 19 (Nuclear and Particle Physics) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The neutron was discovered in 1932 by:
(1932 mein neutron kis ne daryaft kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Rutherford ne 1920 mein aik be-charge particle ki peshgoi ki; James Chadwick ne 1932 mein neutron daryaft kiya (introduction).

book_ref.quote: The prediction came true when James Chadwick discovered neutron in 1932.

blocks.prompt:
2 Rutherford's experiments of 1911 showed that the atom has:
(Rutherford ke 1911 ke tajurbaat ne dikhaya ke atom mein kya hai?)

options.text: bohat chhota, ghana, positive charge wala markazi hissa
poore hajm mein phaile hue neutrons

blocks.explanation: 1911 ke tajurbaat ne aik ghana (dense), positive charge wala chhota sa markazi hissa (nucleus) dikhaya jis ke gird electrons hain.

book_ref.quote: Ernest Rutherford's experiments in 1911 indicated the existence of a dense, positively charged central part

blocks.prompt:
3 From the α-particle scattering experiments, Rutherford concluded that:
(α-particle scattering ke tajurbaat se Rutherford ne kya nateeja nikala?)

options.text: atom zyada tar khaali hai aur mass nucleus mein jama hai
atom ka mass barabar phaila hua hai
atom ka zyada mass electrons mein hai

blocks.explanation: Rutherford ne kaha ke atom ka zyada hissa khaali hai aur mass aik bohat chhote hisse, nucleus, mein jama hai.

book_ref.quote: most of the part of an atom is empty and that mass is concentrated in a very small region called nucleus

blocks.prompt:
4 In the nuclide symbol ᴬ_Z X, the mass number A gives the number of:
(Nuclide ke symbol ᴬ_Z X mein mass number A kis cheez ki tadaad batata hai?)
blocks.explanation: A mass number hai: nucleons (protons + neutrons) ki kul tadaad.

book_ref.quote: 'A' stands for mass number which indicates the total number of nucleons (protons and neutrons)

blocks.prompt:
5 The number of neutrons in the nucleus ¹³¹₅₃I is:
(Nucleus ¹³¹₅₃I mein neutrons ki tadaad kitni hai?)

book_ref.quote: The number of neutrons 'N' in the nucleus is given by A-Z.

blocks.prompt:
6 In the symbol ²³⁹₉₄Pu, the number 94 is the:
(Symbol ²³⁹₉₄Pu mein 94 kya hai?)

options.text: atomic (charge) number, yani protons ki tadaad

blocks.explanation: Neeche wala number Z atomic (charge) number hai jo protons ki tadaad batata hai.

book_ref.quote: 'Z' the atomic or charge number which indicates the numbers of protons

blocks.prompt:
7 Using the orders of magnitude in the chapter (nucleus 10⁻¹⁴ m, atom 10⁻¹⁰ m), the atomic radius is about how many times the nuclear radius?
(Chapter ke orders of magnitude (nucleus 10⁻¹⁴ m, atom 10⁻¹⁰ m) ke mutabiq atom ka radius nucleus ke radius se taqreeban kitne guna hai?)

book_ref.quote: The nucleus is very dense with a radius of the order 10⁻¹⁴ m

blocks.prompt:
8 Experiments show that the mass of a nucleus is:
(Tajurbaat batate hain ke nucleus ka mass:)

options.text: us ke alag protons aur neutrons ke kul mass se hamesha kam
protons aur neutrons ke kul mass se hamesha zyada
protons aur neutrons ke kul mass ke bilkul barabar
sirf protons ke mass ke barabar

blocks.explanation: Nucleus ka mass hamesha us ke protons aur neutrons ke alag alag kul mass se kam hota hai; yeh farq mass defect hai.

book_ref.quote: the mass of the nucleus is always less than the total mass of all the protons and neutrons making up the nucleus

blocks.prompt:
9 The missing mass when nucleons combine to form a nucleus is called:
(Nucleons ke mil kar nucleus banane par jo mass gum hota hai use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Gum hone wala mass, mass defect (mass ki kami) kehlata hai: Δm = [Zmₚ + (A − Z)mₙ] − m_nucleus.

book_ref.quote: The lost or missing mass is called mass defect

blocks.prompt:
10 The energy equivalent of the mass defect Δm is given by:
(Mass defect Δm ke barabar energy kis relation se milti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gum shuda mass Einstein ke relation ΔE = (Δm)c² se energy mein badalta hai.

book_ref.quote: The missing mass is converted to energy, used in the formation of the nucleus.

blocks.prompt:
11 Binding energy of a nucleus is defined as the:
(Nucleus ki binding energy ki definition kya hai?)

options.text: atom se aik electron nikalne ki energy
nucleus ke andar nucleons ki kinetic energy
nucleus ko neutrons aur protons mein torne ke liye kiya gaya kaam
α-particle nikalne par milne wali energy

blocks.explanation: Binding energy woh kaam (work) hai jo nucleus ko us ke neutrons aur protons mein torne ke liye karna parta hai.

book_ref.quote: The work done on the nucleus to break it into constituents neutrons and protons.

blocks.prompt:
12 Binding energy per nucleon is the:
(Binding energy per nucleon kya hai?)

options.text: sirf aik proton nikalne ki energy
nucleus ko alag nucleons mein todne ki ausat energy, har nucleon par

blocks.explanation: Binding energy per nucleon behtar paimana hai: nucleus ko alag nucleons mein todne ke liye har nucleon par ausat energy.

book_ref.quote: average energy needed to separate a nucleus into its individual nucleons

blocks.prompt:
13 Binding energy is taken as negative, like absolute gravitational potential, because that potential is taken as zero:
(Binding energy ko absolute gravitational potential ki tarah negative kyun liya jata hai? Woh potential kahan zero liya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Absolute gravitational potential infinity (la-mehdood faasle) par zero liya jata hai, is liye bound (bandhi hui) energies negative hoti hain.

book_ref.quote: Absolute gravitational potential is taken as zero at infinity

blocks.prompt:
14 One atomic mass unit (1 u) is defined as:
(Aik atomic mass unit (1 u) ki definition kya hai?)

options.text: carbon-12 ke aik atom ke mass ka 1/12

blocks.explanation: 1 u carbon-12 ke aik atom ke mass ka 1/12 hissa hai.

book_ref.quote: 1 u is one-twelfth (1/12) of the mass of an atom of carbon-12

blocks.prompt:
15 In kilograms, 1 u is equal to:
(Kilogram mein 1 u kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: We usually use the masses of sub-atomic particles in atomic mass unit

blocks.prompt:
16 The mass of a helium-3 nucleus (2 protons, 1 neutron) is 5.006412 × 10⁻²⁷ kg. With mₚ = 1.672623 × 10⁻²⁷ kg and mₙ = 1.674929 × 10⁻²⁷ kg, its mass defect is:
(Helium-3 nucleus (2 protons, 1 neutron) ka mass 5.006412 × 10⁻²⁷ kg hai. mₚ = 1.672623 × 10⁻²⁷ kg aur mₙ = 1.674929 × 10⁻²⁷ kg ho to mass defect kitna hai?)

book_ref.quote: Find the mass defect and binding energy of the helium nucleus given that

blocks.prompt:
17 A nucleus has a mass defect of 1.3763 × 10⁻²⁹ kg. Taking c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ and 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J, its binding energy is about:
(Aik nucleus ka mass defect 1.3763 × 10⁻²⁹ kg hai. c = 3.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ aur 1 eV = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J lein to binding energy taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: B.E = Δmc² = 1.239 × 10⁻¹² J; 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ se taqseem = 7.74 MeV.

book_ref.quote: This energy can be calculated from Einstien's mass-energy relation:

blocks.prompt:
18 A tritium nucleus (A = 3) has a binding energy of 8.51 MeV. Its binding energy per nucleon is about:
(Tritium nucleus (A = 3) ki binding energy 8.51 MeV hai. Binding energy per nucleon taqreeban kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: B.E per nucleon = 8.51 / 3 = 2.84 MeV.

book_ref.quote: A better measure is the building energy per nucleon.

blocks.prompt:
19 In the chapter's table of masses, the entry 1.007276 u is the mass of:
(Chapter ki masses wali table mein 1.007276 u kis ka mass hai?)
blocks.explanation: Book correction ke mutabiq 1.007276 u proton ka mass hai; hydrogen-1 atom 1.007825 u hai.

book_ref.quote: In the table, 1.007276 u is the mass of the proton

blocks.prompt:
20 To break a nucleus apart into its protons and neutrons:
(Nucleus ko us ke protons aur neutrons mein todne ke liye:)

options.text: sirf electrons shamil karne parte hain

blocks.explanation: Nucleus ko protons aur neutrons mein todne ke liye energy deni parti hai.

book_ref.quote: Energy must be supplied to break the nucleus apart into its constituent protons and neutrons

blocks.prompt:
21 The binding energy curve is a graph of binding energy per nucleon against:
(Binding energy curve mein binding energy per nucleon kis ke muqable mein banayi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Curve mein binding energy per nucleon ko nucleon number A ke muqable mein banaya jata hai.

book_ref.quote: It is useful to draw a graphical curve of binding energy per nucleon against the nucleon number

blocks.prompt:
22 The binding energy of the ordinary hydrogen nucleus (one proton) is:
(Aam hydrogen nucleus (aik proton) ki binding energy kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Akele proton ko kisi se bandhna nahi, is liye binding energy zero hai.

book_ref.quote: initially the hydrogen nucleus with just one proton has a binding energy zero

blocks.prompt:
23 The binding energy per nucleon reaches its maximum, about 8.7 MeV, for:
(Binding energy per nucleon apni sab se zyada qeemat (taqreeban 8.7 MeV) kis ke liye leti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Curve iron-56 (⁵⁶₂₆Fe) par taqreeban 8.7 MeV ki chouti tak pohanchta hai; yeh sab se mustahkam (stable) nuclide hai.

book_ref.quote: The curve reaches a maximum value of about 8.7 MeV for that of iron

blocks.prompt:
24 According to the curve, the most stable nuclei have nucleon numbers between:
(Curve ke mutabiq sab se stable nuclei ka nucleon number kis range mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sab se stable nuclei A = 50 aur A = 80 ke darmiyan hain.

book_ref.quote: The region of most stable nuclei is between nucleon number 'A' equal to 50 and 80.

blocks.prompt:
25 Binding energy per nucleon is less for:
(Binding energy per nucleon kin nuclei ke liye kam hai?)

options.text: bohat halke aur bohat bhaari nuclei

blocks.explanation: Bohat halke aur bohat bhaari nuclei ke liye binding energy per nucleon kam hai; darmiyani nuclei mein sab se zyada.

book_ref.quote: Thus binding energy per nucleon is less for very light and very heavy nuclei.

blocks.prompt:
26 Energy is obtained from a nuclear reaction when the binding energy per nucleon of the products:
(Nuclear reaction se energy tab milti hai jab products ki binding energy per nucleon:)
blocks.explanation: Jis nuclear reaction mein products ki binding energy per nucleon barh jaye, us se energy milti hai.

book_ref.quote: energy is obtained from any nuclear reaction in which the binding energy per nucleon of the products increases

blocks.prompt:
27 The large step on the curve from hydrogen to helium suggests that:
(Curve par hydrogen se helium tak bara farq kya batata hai?)

options.text: hydrogen ko helium banane par bohat energy kharij hoti hai
hydrogen se helium nahi ban sakta
hydrogen helium se zyada stable hai
helium banane ke liye energy deni parti hai

blocks.explanation: Hydrogen se helium tak bara farq batata hai ke hydrogen ko helium mein badalne par bohat energy kharij hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The fall from hydrogen to helium is large

blocks.prompt:
28 Fusing a pair of light nuclei on the binding energy curve is not easy because it needs:
(Curve ke halke nuclei ko jorna (fuse karna) aasaan kyun nahi?)

options.text: bohat zyada temperature, jaise Suraj aur sitaron mein

blocks.explanation: Yeh amal shuru karna mushkil hai; is ke liye bohat zyada temperature chahiye jaisa Suraj aur sitaron mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: needs extremely high temperature such as occurring naturally in our Sun and other stars

blocks.prompt:
29 Nuclear fission of uranium by slow neutrons was discovered by:
(Slow neutrons se uranium ka fission kis ne daryaft kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Germany ke Otto Hahn aur Fritz Strassmann ne dekha ke slow neutrons uranium-235 par lagne se Ba, Kr aur neutrons bante hain.

book_ref.quote: Otto Hahn and Fritz Strassmann of Germany

blocks.prompt:
30 A reaction in which a heavy nucleus splits into two nuclei of roughly equal size with the release of energy is called:
(Jis reaction mein bhaari nucleus taqreeban barabar size ke do nuclei mein toot jaye aur energy nikle, use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh fission reaction (nucleus ka tootna) ki definition hai.

book_ref.quote: A reaction in which a heavy nucleus like that of uranium splits up into two nuclei of roughly equal size

blocks.prompt:
31 Fission differs from other nuclear reactions in that:
(Fission doosri nuclear reactions se kaise mukhtalif hai?)

options.text: products hamesha uranium se bhaari hote hain
nucleus barabar size ke do nuclei mein toot-ta hai aur bohat energy nikalti hai
sirf aik neutron banta hai, koi nucleus nahi

blocks.explanation: Fission mein taqreeban barabar size ke do nuclei bante hain aur bohat zyada energy nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: two nuclei of almost equal size are obtained

blocks.prompt:
32 The energy released in the fission of one uranium-235 nucleus is about:
(Uranium-235 ke aik nucleus ke fission mein taqreeban kitni energy nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik uranium nucleus ke fission mein taqreeban 200 MeV energy nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: in the fission of one uranium nucleus, about 200 MeV energy is given out

blocks.prompt:
33 In a balanced fission equation, which quantities are the same on both sides?
(Balanced fission equation mein dono taraf kya barabar rehta hai?)

options.text: mass numbers ka jor aur charge numbers ka jor

blocks.explanation: Dono taraf mass numbers ka jor aur charge numbers ka jor barabar hota hai.

book_ref.quote: there is no difference between the sum of the mass and the charge numbers on both sides of the equation

blocks.prompt:
34 In the fission ²³⁵₉₂U + ¹₀n → ¹⁴⁴₅₆Ba + ᴬ_Z Kr + 3¹₀n, the krypton nucleus has:
(Fission ²³⁵₉₂U + ¹₀n → ¹⁴⁴₅₆Ba + ᴬ_Z Kr + 3¹₀n mein krypton nucleus ke A aur Z kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Mass numbers: 236 = 144 + A + 3, A = 89. Charge numbers: 92 = 56 + Z, Z = 36.

book_ref.quote: Two possible fission reactions of uranium are given below as an example:

blocks.prompt:
35 The binding energy per nucleon of uranium is about 7.6 MeV and that of its fission products barium and krypton is about 8.5 MeV. The energy given out per nucleon is about:
(Uranium ki binding energy per nucleon taqreeban 7.6 MeV aur barium/krypton ki 8.5 MeV hai. Har nucleon par kitni energy nikalti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Har nucleon par energy = 8.5 − 7.6 = 0.9 MeV.

book_ref.quote: the binding energy per nucleon for uranium is about 7.6 MeV

blocks.prompt:
36 Suppose a nucleus with A = 240 and binding energy per nucleon 7.5 MeV splits into fragments with 8.4 MeV per nucleon. The energy released is about:
(Farz karein A = 240 aur 7.5 MeV per nucleon wala nucleus aise tukron mein toot-ta hai jin ki binding energy 8.4 MeV per nucleon hai. Kitni energy nikalegi?)

book_ref.quote: This means that an energy 235 × 0.9 = 211.5 MeV is given out

blocks.prompt:
37 The fission of uranium-235:
(Uranium-235 ka fission:)

options.text: mukhtalif jore de sakta hai, jaise Ba + Kr, Sn + Mo, Xe + Sr
hamesha sirf barium aur krypton deta hai
hamesha do helium nuclei deta hai

blocks.explanation: Fission hamesha aik jaise tukre nahi deta; Ba + Kr, Sn + Mo, Xe + Sr sab mumkin hain.

book_ref.quote: The fission process of uranium does not always produce the same fragments

blocks.prompt:
38 The fission fragments of uranium are:
(Uranium ke fission fragments kaise hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Fission ke tamam products (fragments) radioactive hote hain.

book_ref.quote: All of these products (fission fragments) are radioactive.

blocks.prompt:
39 Fission takes place very easily with slow neutrons in:
(Slow neutrons se fission sab se aasani se kin mein hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Slow neutrons se uranium-235 aur plutonium-239 mein fission aasani se hota hai.

book_ref.quote: fission takes place very easily with the slow neutrons in uranium-235 and plutonium-239

blocks.prompt:
40 Which statement about fission is correct?
(Fission ke baare mein kaunsa bayan durust hai?)

options.text: kai bhaari elements mein mumkin hai, sirf uranium mein nahi
sirf halke elements mein hota hai

blocks.explanation: Fission sirf uranium tak mehdood nahi; kai doosre bhaari elements mein bhi mumkin hai.

book_ref.quote: Fission reaction is not confined to uranium alone

blocks.prompt:
41 A fission reaction that continuously maintains itself by the neutrons it releases is called:
(Jo fission reaction apne nikle hue neutrons se khud ko jaari rakhe use kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nikle hue neutrons se mazeed fission kar ke reaction ko jaari rakhna fission chain reaction hai.

book_ref.quote: This process is called fission chain reaction.

blocks.prompt:
42 When a uranium-235 nucleus absorbs a neutron and undergoes fission, the number of neutrons emitted is:
(Uranium-235 nucleus neutron jazb kar ke fission kare to kitne neutrons nikalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Nucleus barabar mass ke do nuclei mein toot-ta hai aur do ya teen neutrons nikalte hain.

book_ref.quote: breaks into two nuclei of almost equal masses besides emitting two or three neutrons

blocks.prompt:
43 In a thin sheet of fissile material, no chain reaction occurs because:
(Fissile material ki patli chadar mein chain reaction kyun nahi hota?)

options.text: neutrons hawa mein nikal jate hain
chadar saari energy jazb kar leti hai

blocks.explanation: Patli chadar mein neutrons hawa mein bikhar kar nikal jate hain, is liye chain reaction nahi hota.

book_ref.quote: The resulting neutrons scatter in the air and so they cannot produce any fission chain reaction.

blocks.prompt:
44 The mass of uranium in which one neutron out of all those produced in one fission produces further fission is called:
(Uranium ka woh mass jis mein aik fission ke tamam neutrons mein se aik neutron mazeed fission kare, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh critical mass ki definition hai.

book_ref.quote: Such a mass of uranium in which one neutron, out of all the neutrons produced in one fission reaction, produces further fission is called critical mass.

blocks.prompt:
45 The volume of the critical mass of uranium is called:
(Critical mass ke uranium ka hajm (volume) kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Critical mass ka hajm critical volume ya size kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: The volume of this mass of uranium is called critical volume or size.

blocks.prompt:
46 An atom bomb uses uranium whose mass is:
(Atom bomb mein uranium ka mass kaisa hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mass critical se bohat zyada ho to chain reaction tezi se barhta hai aur dhamaka hota hai; atom bomb isi par chalta hai.

book_ref.quote: Atom bomb works at this principle.

blocks.prompt:
47 If the mass of uranium is less than the critical mass, the chain reaction:
(Agar uranium ka mass critical mass se kam ho to chain reaction:)

options.text: apni ibtidai raftar se chalta hai

blocks.explanation: Critical mass se kam par chain reaction aage nahi barhta.

book_ref.quote: If the mass of uranium is less than the critical mass, the chain reaction does not proceed.

blocks.prompt:
48 An atomic reactor obtains steady energy because its uranium mass is kept:
(Atomic reactor ko mustaqil energy is liye milti hai ke us ka uranium mass:)
blocks.explanation: Critical mass ke barabar mass par chain reaction apni ibtidai raftar se chalta hai; reactor isi usool par kaam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: If the mass of uranium is equal to the critical mass, the chain reaction proceeds at its initial speed

blocks.prompt:
49 Cadmium is used in control rods because it:
(Control rods mein cadmium kyun istemal hota hai?)

options.text: bohat se neutrons jazb karta hai aur khud radioactive nahi banta
neutrons ko jazb kiye baghair slow karta hai

blocks.explanation: Cadmium bohat se neutrons jazb kar leta hai aur khud unstable ya radioactive nahi banta.

book_ref.quote: Cadmium is an element that is capable of absorbing a large number of neutrons without becoming unstable or radioactive.

blocks.prompt:
50 In a controlled chain reaction, the number of neutrons from each fission that, on the average, causes another fission is:
(Controlled chain reaction mein har fission ke kitne neutrons ausatan agla fission karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Controlled chain reaction mein ausatan sirf aik neutron agla fission karta hai, is liye energy mustaqil raftar se nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: only one neutron, out of all the neutrons created in one fission reaction, becomes the cause of further fission reaction

blocks.prompt:
51 An uncontrolled chain reaction in a large amount of uranium-235 produces:
(Bare miqdaar ke uranium-235 mein be-qaboo chain reaction kya paida karta hai?)

options.text: bohat kam waqt mein bohat energy aur bara dhamaka

blocks.explanation: Neutrons ke barhte fission se bohat kam waqt mein bohat energy aur bara dhamaka hota hai.

book_ref.quote: a large amount of energy along with huge explosion is produced

blocks.prompt:
52 In a nuclear power station, the reactor plays the same part as the:
(Nuclear power station mein reactor ka kaam thermal power station ke kis hisse jaisa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Reactor furnace (bhatti) jaisa kaam karta hai: wahan koila/tel jalta hai, yahan fission heat paida karta hai.

book_ref.quote: the reactor plays the same part as does furnace in a thermal power station

blocks.prompt:
53 The energy released in fission first appears as:
(Fission mein nikalne wali energy sab se pehle kis shakal mein hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fission energy pehle fragments ki kinetic energy hoti hai jo takraon se heat ban jati hai.

book_ref.quote: This energy appears in the form of kinetic energy of the fission fragments.

blocks.prompt:
54 The most important part of a reactor, where the fuel is kept, is the:
(Reactor ka sab se aham hissa jahan fuel rakha jata hai:)
blocks.explanation: Core sab se aham hissa hai; fuel wahan cylindrical tubes mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The most important and vital part of a reactor is called core.

blocks.prompt:
55 In natural uranium, the share of uranium-235 is only about:
(Qudrati uranium mein uranium-235 ka hissa sirf taqreeban kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Qudrati uranium mein sirf 0.7% uranium-235 hai; reactor fuel mein ise 2.4-3.0% tak barhaya (enrich) jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Point 1 leaves out the isotope: it is the quantity of uranium-235

blocks.prompt:
56 Besides enriched uranium-235, which are also used as reactor fuels nowadays?
(Enriched uranium-235 ke ilawa aaj kal kaunse reactor fuel istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aaj kal plutonium-239 aur uranium-233 bhi fuel ke tor par istemal hote hain.

book_ref.quote: Nowadays plutonium-239 and uranium-233 are also being used as fuel.

blocks.prompt:
57 The function of a moderator in a nuclear reactor is to:
(Nuclear reactor mein moderator ka kaam kya hai?)

options.text: fission ke neutrons ko slow karna

blocks.explanation: Moderator fission ke tez neutrons ko slow karta hai kyunke fission ke liye slow neutrons behtar hain.

book_ref.quote: The function of these moderators is to slow down the speed of the neutrons produced during the fission process

blocks.prompt:
58 Which of the following is used as a moderator?
(In mein se kaunsa moderator ke tor par istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Moderator kam atomic weight wale maadde hain jaise paani ya heavy water.

book_ref.quote: The fuel rods are placed in a substance of small atomic weight, such as water or heavy water.

blocks.prompt:
59 Heavy water differs from ordinary water because its hydrogen is:
(Heavy water aam paani se kaise mukhtalif hai? Is ka hydrogen:)
blocks.explanation: Heavy water mein ¹₁H ki jagah ²₁H (hydrogen ka bhaari isotope) hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Heavy water, it may be remembered, is made of

blocks.prompt:
60 Control rods made of cadmium or boron work because these elements:
(Cadmium ya boron ki control rods kyun kaam karti hain?)

options.text: tez neutrons zyada aur slow kam jazb karte hain
slow (thermal) neutrons ko zyada jazb karte hain
jazb kiye baghair neutrons slow karte hain

blocks.explanation: Book correction ke mutabiq cadmium aur boron slow (thermal) neutrons ko zyada jazb karte hain; rods tak pohanchne wale neutrons moderator se slow ho chuke hote hain.

book_ref.quote: cadmium and boron absorb slow (thermal) neutrons strongly and fast neutrons only weakly

blocks.prompt:
61 In an emergency, a reactor is shut down by:
(Emergency mein reactor kaise band kiya jata hai?)

options.text: control rods ko poori tarah reactor mein girana

blocks.explanation: Emergency ya marammat ke liye control rods reactor mein gira di jati hain jis se chain reaction ruk jata hai.

book_ref.quote: control rods are allowed to fall back into the reactor and thus stop the chain reaction

blocks.prompt:
62 The temperature of a reactor core rises to about:
(Reactor core ka temperature taqreeban kitna ho jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chain reaction ki heat se core ka temperature taqreeban 500 °C ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The temperature of the core, therefore, rises to about 500 °C.

blocks.prompt:
63 In a nuclear power station, high temperature steam is produced from ordinary water in the:
(Nuclear power station mein aam paani se garam steam kahan banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Core ki heat heat exchanger tak le jayi jati hai jahan aam paani se garam steam banti hai.

book_ref.quote: In the heat exchanger, this heat is used to produce high temperature steam from ordinary water.

blocks.prompt:
64 The radiation symbol shown in the chapter is used to indicate:
(Chapter mein diya gaya radiation symbol kya zahir karta hai?)

options.text: woh jagah jahan radioactivity istemal ya artificial radiation paida hoti hai

blocks.explanation: Yeh symbol aisi jagah batata hai jahan radioactivity istemal hoti hai ya artificial radiations banti hain.

book_ref.quote: This symbol is universally used to indicate an area where radioactivity is being handled

blocks.prompt:
65 The total output capacity of Pakistan's nuclear power plants (Karachi and Chashma) is:
(Pakistan ke nuclear power plants (Karachi aur Chashma) ki kul output capacity kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kul output capacity 3000 MW se zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: The total is still more than 3000 MW.

blocks.prompt:
66 The best place so far found to store nuclear waste is:
